```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(fpp3)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4
)
source("lab_submission.R")

lab_meta <- list(id = "lab05", title = "STL and Box–Cox")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "STL stands for:",
  q2 = "Guerrero’s λ is chosen mainly to:",
  q3 = "Report λ (approx) and whether the transformed remainder looks cleaner."
)
```

## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## STL
```{r stl-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=6}
library(fpp3)
aus_production |>
  model(STL(Beer ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("Seasonal and Trend decomposition using Loess", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Simple Trend Lag"),
  answer("Seasonal Transfer Learning"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

## Box–Cox + STL
```{r boxcox-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=8}
lambda <- aus_production |> features(Beer, guerrero) |> pull(lambda_guerrero)
lambda
aus_production |>
  model(STL(box_cox(Beer, lambda))) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Stabilise seasonal variation / variance with level", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Maximise AICc of ARIMA only"),
  answer("Force d=2 differencing"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "λ ≈ …; remainder …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

Answer the questions above first, type your name, download the `.txt`, and upload it.

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")

```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
